rules.sql: SELECT payload.event_id as event_id, payload.asset_id as asset_id, payload.device_class as device_class, payload.metric_name as metric_name, payload.value as value, payload.event_ts as event_ts, payload.quality_flag as quality_flag FROM "site/+/asset/+/+"
rules.description: Bridges MQTT telemetry events to Kafka main raw ingress
